kinds.text: {name} owes the moneylenders of three towns more than a councillor's purse could ever cover
{name} slips out to a lover across town most nights, and their household doesn't know
{name} has wagons that pass the gate unsearched, and a cellar full of what they carry
{name} keeps a shrine to a forbidden god behind a false wall in their cellar
{name} fled another town under another name, and someone there still wants them hanged
{name} takes coin from a merchant house to vote its way

secrets.found: The mayor's people come back with what they were sent for: {secret}.
secrets.clean: The mayor's people dig into {name}, {seat}, and find nothing worse than a fondness for long speeches.
secrets.caught: {name} hears that the mayor's people have been asking questions about them, and is cold in the council chamber after.
secrets.heard: Tavern talk reaches the mayor's ear: {secret}.
secrets.press: A quiet word with {name} before the vote, about what the mayor knows. The {seat} votes {vote}, and won't meet the mayor's eye.
secrets.leaked: Word gets out that the mayor leaned on {name} with what they know. The town doesn't like how its council is run.
secrets.expose: Before the whole council the mayor lays it out: {secret}. {name} gives up the seat of {seat} and leaves the chamber.
